create.name: Sura Kim
create.bio:
Sura Kim, who teaches simply as Sura, is a meditation coach and trainer based in the Seattle area who also spends part of the year in Hawaii. She came to meditation from finance: a chartered financial analyst, she worked at Goldman Sachs, in technology investment and in institutional sales in New York before the pressure of that life led her to a daily practice. She later left the city to study meditation in rural Asia, and long personal retreats in British Columbia shaped the method she now calls Sura Flow. She is also a Reiki Master and yoga teacher and holds an executive coaching certificate from Georgetown University.

Sura Flow is a short, heart-centred practice in three steps, relax, listen and intend, that works with imagination, the body and personal energy rather than trying to empty the mind. She frames it as bringing a feminine perspective to meditation, welcoming emotion, desire and self-expression. She set out the approach in her book Sura Flow and founded the Meditation Coaching Alliance, and through her LIBERATE programme she trains coaches, therapists and teachers over eight months online, with in-person retreats in Washington State. She also coaches executives one to one and has spoken at TEDx.

courses.title: LIBERATE Certified Meditation Coach Training
courses.description: Her flagship eight-month certification, taught live online with in-person retreat time in Washington State. Trainees learn several meditation styles, energy practices and coaching skills, and practise guiding sessions one to one and in groups. New cohorts start each year.

courses.title: Guided Beginner Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: A four-week introduction to guiding meditation, delivered as weekly recorded webinars with practice and Q&A sessions, homework and a final live evaluation with a senior coach. Materials stay available for a year.

courses.title: Manifest with Energy
courses.description: A short self-paced workshop in six parts on working with energy and intention, with grounding and balancing practices and guided journaling.

courses.title: The Expanded Chakra System for Women
courses.description: An online course that goes beyond the usual seven chakras to further energy centres, with practices for grounding, calm and intuition that can be used alone or with clients.

courses.title: Energy Healing Techniques for Beginners
courses.description: About three hours of recorded lessons with slides, transcripts, guided energy practices and worksheets, for meditators who want to become more aware of subtle energy.

courses.title: Meditation for Relaxation
courses.description: A 21-day beginners' course of short daily guided meditation videos with journal prompts, starting with posture and breath and building a simple daily habit.

courses.title: How to Teach Meditation (3-Part Mini Course)
courses.description: A three-session Insight Timer course on the basics of guiding others in meditation, drawn from her coach-training work.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Sura Kim on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short guided meditations on the heart, focus and inner voice, along with practices on energy and intuition, all free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Guided walking meditation
free_resources.description: A free article and practice from her blog on bringing meditative attention to an everyday walk, using the senses to stay present.

flags: Her own site uses only 'Sura'; the surname Kim appears on her course platform ('Tori Deal and Sura Kim'), her International Coaching Federation profile and Spirituality & Health author page. Listed as Sura Kim; check she is happy with that.

Much of her marketing is framed around stress relief for executives and her site mentions depression and burnout in her story; none of that is used, and stress- and anxiety-titled products are left out.
No published email; contact form (ActiveCampaign) on /contact/.

Upcoming book 'The Meditation Coaching Method': not yet published.
